title: Attributes
html:
In Dungeon Runners, there are four basic characteristics that define what types of skills your character accelerate at. Each time you level up, you are given five attribute points to place among these attributes as you wish. You may also remove all your points from your attributes to reassign them differently by hitting the Re-Spec button on your character statistics display screen.


The four attributes are:

  • Strength - Boosts melee attack damage and Defense Rating.
  • Agility - Increases your ranged attack damage and Attack Rating.
  • Endurance - Increases your health.
  • Intellect - Increases your spell damage and mana capacity.


Magical items in the game frequently boost one or more of these attributes.
